title: When the Thorn Turns Revisited
author: Ansel Quintana
blurb: Astrid Thornbury, a thief who steals memories, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
